title: PaySaathi 1.2.1 — Tenant security and domain verification
notes: Hardened client table grants for private gateway, service catalogue, OTP and wallet-security records; corrected tenant membership row visibility.
Added server-side DNS TXT ownership verification for Enterprise custom domains and integrated domain registration/verification in White-label Studio.
Added White-label Studio for platform-owner workspace creation and business-owner brand customisation.
Added the first secure white-label tenant foundation: separate business workspaces, membership roles, branding records, subscription metadata and tenant audit logs.
Customer dashboard language now matches a personal customer account instead of a retailer portal.
Transaction history now supports live client-side search and filters for recharges, payouts, AEPS and failed transactions.
Unavailable DMT, AEPS and payout previews no longer collect Aadhaar, beneficiary, bank or transfer details.
Support agent online/offline presence is no longer exposed by the public support directory.
Restricted public execution of internal security-definer helper and trigger functions; signed-in application role checks remain in place.
Improved customer-facing update notes and refreshed app shell cache version.
Payment and regulated services remain disabled until verified providers and required compliance integrations are configured.
Expanded transaction history filters with dedicated bill-payment and wallet-activity views.
Clarified that the automated support guide provides guided answers and does not verify live transaction status; customers can raise a human support ticket.
Transaction history now distinguishes successful, processing, pending, failed, rejected and cancelled states accurately.
Public support directory now returns only the agent display name and required identifier; private staff notes, availability and online/offline presence are not exposed.
This is a foundation release only: existing wallet, transaction, KYC, support and operations tables are not yet tenant-isolated; commercial tenant onboarding remains disabled.
